project.description: Updates NCBI gene start/end positions from the GRCz11 RefSeq feature table (GCF_000002035.6_GRCz11_feature_table.txt.gz). NCBI no longer publishes this file at its old FTP location, so it is supplied either by upload or by a local path.

hudson.model.FileParameterDefinition.name: FEATURE_TABLE_UPLOAD
hudson.model.FileParameterDefinition.description: Optional. Upload the feature table (.txt or .txt.gz). If provided, it takes precedence over FEATURE_TABLE_PATH.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: FEATURE_TABLE_PATH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Local path to the feature table (.txt or .txt.gz). Used when no file is uploaded.
